chiku.ask: After 30 days of train rides, Noor, 20, opens her flashcard app as the train leaves. What starts it? Give me one card.

newDay.caption: New day: Noor takes a bus instead, with time and the same wish to study.
newDay.question: Will she open her flashcard app as usual?

guesses.why: Your card says the train starts it. No train today.
Your card says 30 days locked it in. Her 30 days are done.
Your card says her wish starts it. She still wants to study.

truth.caption: On the bus, Noor's phone stayed in her pocket. She forgot the app.

chiku.ask: A cafe offers Leila, 22, a free coin toss: win $20 or get $0. Why is yes an easy choice? Give me one card.

newDay.caption: New day: The cafe hands Leila $10 first. The toss could win her $10 more or lose that $10.
newDay.question: Will she take the toss now?

guesses.why: Your card says she judges from her start. Today the toss can take $10 from it, and a loss weighs more than a same-size gain.
Your card says gaining or losing $10 feels equal. The fair toss still looks fine.
Your card says the starting point changes nothing. She said yes to a toss before.

truth.caption: Leila kept the sure $10 and passed on the toss.

chiku.ask: Maya, 24, plans to offer $50 for a used desk. She sees a $100 tag, does not question it, and offers $70. Why? Give me one card.

cards.text: Questioning it would erase the pull

newDay.caption: New day: For another desk, a random wheel lands on $100. Maya lists two reasons it is too high.
newDay.question: Will she still offer more than her $50 plan?

guesses.why: Your card says a first number pulls offers, even a random one she doubts.
Your card says only real prices pull. A random number will not, so she offers $50.
Your card says questioning it erases the pull. She did, so she offers $50.

truth.caption: Maya offered $55. Her reasons shrank the pull, but it was still there.

chiku.ask: Omar, 21, has seen three late buses. He guesses every bus on his route is late. What can show if he is right? Give me one card.

newDay.caption: New day: Omar sees two more late buses, then one early bus.
newDay.question: Does his every-bus-is-late guess still hold?

guesses.why: Your card says watch for an early bus. One came, so 'every bus is late' fails.
Your card says one late bus proves it. He saw two today, so it holds.
Your card says many late buses prove it. He has seen five now, so it holds.

truth.caption: One early bus shows not every bus is late. Omar crossed out his guess.

chiku.ask: Eva, 19, sees her friends all point to platform 2. What does a whole group agreeing tell her? Give me one card.

newDay.caption: New day: The sign clearly says platform 3, but a group of strangers points to platform 2.
newDay.question: Will Eva walk to platform 3?

guesses.why: Your card says a group is a clue, not proof. The clear sign says 3.
Your card says the group proves it. She goes with platform 2.
Your card says everyone follows the crowd. So Eva does too.

truth.caption: Eva read the sign and walked to platform 3.

chiku.ask: Theo, 20, plans a new poster. His last one ran an hour over, in the printer line. Which idea helps his plan? Give me one card.

newDay.caption: New day: Theo makes the poster on a 2-hour plan with no time for the printer line.
newDay.question: Will the poster take longer than 2 hours?

guesses.why: Your card says past tasks show time a plan misses. The printer line can add an hour again.
Your card says the smooth plan is normal. So 2 hours is enough.
Your card says past tasks cannot help. So the last printer line tells him nothing.

truth.caption: The printer line took an hour again. The poster took 3 hours.

chiku.ask: After learning new words, Inez, 23, puts her book away and rests before a quiz. Why rest? Give me one card.

newDay.caption: New day: Inez learns another word list, then can sleep or do chores until the quiz.
newDay.question: Will she sleep after studying?

guesses.why: Your card says rest helps keep new learning. Sleep after learning can cut forgetting.
Your card says staying up works better. She stays awake.
Your card says busy breaks help more. She does chores instead.

truth.caption: Inez slept after studying, then took the quiz.

chiku.ask: At an arcade, Sam, 18, keeps trying a prize box that pays after a changing number of tries. Why keep trying? Give me one card.

cards.text: It all comes down to willpower

newDay.caption: New day: Sam is rested and calm. His first three tries win nothing, and the next prize has no set turn.
newDay.question: Will he try the box again?

guesses.why: Your card says he never knows which try will pay. That keeps tries going after empty ones.
Your card says it comes down to willpower. He is rested today, so he stops.
Your card says uneven prizes fade faster than steady ones. Three empty tries end it.

truth.caption: Sam put in another coin after the three empty tries.

chiku.ask: On campus, Hana, 22, opens her notebook to study when the 8 a.m. bus arrives, as she planned. What starts it? Give me one card.

cards.text: The named bus is her cue

newDay.caption: New day: The bus is cancelled, but Hana has a free hour at home with her notebook.
newDay.question: Will she open it during that hour?

guesses.why: Your card says the bus is her named cue. That cue never comes today.
Your card says her wish is enough. She still wants to study.
Your card says one sharp cue costs nothing. She uses this other free hour.

truth.caption: Hana used the free hour for other tasks and left the notebook shut.

chiku.ask: At a workshop, Zoya, 25, feels sure all six classmates noticed her bright shirt. How many really did? Give me one card.

cards.text: Some, but fewer than she thinks

newDay.caption: New day: Zoya wears a bright shirt to another six-person workshop, then asks who recalls it.
newDay.question: Will she write 'some noticed' in her notebook?

guesses.why: Your card says some notice, but fewer than her own view suggests.
Your card says all six noticed it. She writes 'all noticed'.
Your card says nobody notices. She writes 'none noticed'.

truth.caption: One classmate recalled the shirt, so Zoya wrote 'some noticed'.
